corrections.optical: Exclude only positively observed DRIVE_CDROM=5 from irrelevant storage disk-number queries; log classification and keep catalog name.
corrections.RAM: Exclude only an opened volume whose kernel object name and complete held RAM backing match the actual current environment; do not infer RAM from failed DEVICE.
corrections.lock_only_handles: Keep LOCK and DISMOUNT; remove unused extended-DASD boundary-check permission because actual source data I/O uses PhysicalDrive, not these volume handles.
corrections.strict_source_checks_retained: Full native GPT/partition identity, complete catalog, selected_seen, real source locks held until SET3 and all source/J/boot/writer gates.
corrections.failure_evidence: Include path, drive type, operation and native error; drain actual failed exclusion events to the independent log before returning.
